notes.body: mentioned in issue #17192
changed title from headers: Fix already shipped public headers to headers: Fix some public headers
changed title from headers: Fix some public headers to headers: Fix some public header inclusions
Shouldn't this be just "packet-xml.h" (remove dissectors/ not require <> )
Shouldn't this work if packet.h is in the directory?
Why is the explicit epan/ needed for files in the epan directory itself?

In the public headers epan/ is needed, otherwise the header would not be found as discussed to some extent in #17192. In the .c files and private headers this is not functionally needed, but IMO using the full path in the project is a better practice. I'm a bit used to it following https://google.github.io/styleguide/cppguide.html#Header_Files .
`""` vs `<>` : IMO the public headers should be included consistently with `<>`.
Yea, I didn't want to open the can of worms #17192 hints at as far as "developer preferences". We're all after consistency, we just have different ideas of it.

I just read our dev README again:
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/948c4c4f8c20704df912b1d86c3441ebdc38768b/doc/README.developer

For public headers we need to use <> and use the full path.
@mmann78 Do you feel this thread still unresolved?
I think I was just worried about #17192 and/or was some/all of that resolved with this (and should be referenced in the commit)
